subject: general
question: _______ is the leading manganese ore producing State of India and accounted for 33% of the total production in 2018-19.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Manganese **is a mineral that naturally occurs in a **silvery grey **color and is exceedingly **hard **and **brittle.**
 
• It is constantly combined with minerals like **laterite**, **iron**, and others.
 
• Steel production requires **manganese **in the form of an **alloy**, and **steel production **is one of the most significant markers of growth in any nation's industrial sector.
 
• India's top manganese producer in** Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• India is currently one of the main countries importing **manganese ore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Other states in India that produce manganese include** Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• Madhya Pradesh produced almost **33% **of all the **manganese produced **in India in** 2019–20.**
 
• Maharashtra produced almost **25%** of all the **manganese produced **in India in** 2019–20.**
 
• Around **18%** of India's total **manganese production **in **2019–20 **was produced in **Odisha**.
 
• **Karnataka **and **Andhra Pradesh **made about** 11%** each of the nation's manganese production in **2019–20.**
